explication: reviewdog turns linter output into diagnostics, compares them with patch diffs, filters findings, and reports them locally or to code-hosting review interfaces. Its CLI also supports configured tool runners and CI context. The repository includes a separate GitHub App service that accepts annotations, filters them against pull-request diffs, and publishes checks. The README documents additional input formats and reporters; some of those adapters are represented at their enclosing directory because their implementation was not sampled. Relationships below are limited to sampled references, visible calls, and README documentation.
